how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from www.srtmun.ac.in.

Send the completed application to [email protected], or submit it by Registered Post or in person to The Secretary, Marathwada Gramin Shikshan Sanstha's, Hutatma Jaywantrao Patil Mahavidyalaya, Himayatnagar-431802, Dist-Nanded, within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.
Attach attested copies of certificates and other relevant documents.
Reserved category candidates also send one copy to the Assistant Registrar, Special Cell, Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded, by Registered Post only.
Candidates already in service apply through proper channel.
Email it on or before 10 December 2026.
important_instructions: No T.A./D.A. will be paid to attend the interview 30% and 4% seats are reserved for women and disabled persons respectively, according to Govt. rules Relaxation of 5% marks at P.G. level for SC/ST candidates only (Note 06) Permission as per NOC No.: JDHE/Nanded/NOC/2026/00016, Dt. 11.09.2026
